_comment: WO-1679 / HEART-006 + WO-1682 / HEART-009 - THE ONE AUTHORED BENEFIT TABLE.
Spec: docs/specs/HEARTBOUND_SKR_RESONANCE_WORK_ORDERS_2026-09-10.md:617-748 (HEART-006)
⛔ THIS FILE HOLDS NO TIER THRESHOLDS. The ladder - which score reaches which tier -
lives in api/_lib/heartbound-resonance-config.json and NOWHERE ELSE. This table is
keyed by tier NUMBER and says only what that tier GRANTS. A threshold copied here
would be the duplicated-state failure CLAUDE.md §2/§5/§8/§16 each record a scar from,
and api/_lib/heartbound-tiers.js therefore resolves every tier by CALLING
heartbound-resonance.js rather than by reading anything below.
⛔ AND THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO CANONICAL TWIN UNDER Assets/. Spec :1274 - 'UI
contains no staking calculations'. The client is TOLD its benefits by the backend;
it never derives them from a tier number it holds. HeartboundBenefitsRegression
fails if any file under Assets/ grows a per-tier benefit table.
⚠ Q-CONFIG (RULED 2026-09-10 13:36): these knobs belong on the Command Center as
SERVER-ONLY rows. api/_lib/tunable-manifest.js now understands a serverOnly marker
(WO-1682 D3); the rows themselves land when the console page can render one - see
WORK_ORDER_1682_...RESULT.md, 'what was NOT done'.
HEART-009 spec :903-910: 'Direct recurring production modifiers from Heartbound
should initially remain below 10% combined effective economic acceleration.'
⛔ Q-METER (RULED 2026-09-10 13:36, owner): 'production-rate modifiers only - the
10% ceiling is the sum of the passive tier percentage boosts to resource yield;
TIMERS AND EVENT DROPS ARE NOT COUNTED.' So the meter in heartbound-tiers.js sums
EXACTLY the benefit rows whose kind is 'productionRate' and nothing else. Rows of
kind eventUnlock / information / polishAttempts / presentation are EXCLUDED BY THE
RULING, not by oversight, and the meter reports them in `excluded` so the exclusion
is visible rather than silent.
⛔ AND THE SUM IS CUMULATIVE OVER THE WHOLE LADDER. A Tier X player holds every
lower tier's passive too, so the number that must stay under the ceiling is the sum
across ALL tiers - which is what test/heartbound-tiers.test.js measures.
⚠ Q-CLIENTECON (RULED 2026-09-10 13:32): THIS CEILING IS A DESIGN GUARDRAIL, NOT AN
ANTI-CHEAT CONTROL. The modifiers are applied client-side (api/game/save.js:410-421:
farming/raiding/dungeons/arena 'are simulated entirely on the client'), so a modified
client can ignore it. That is the same honest posture api/game/save.js:70-72 already
takes for soft currency ('anti-grief / anti-corruption ceilings, NOT a
server-authoritative economy'). Rate modifiers stay; the cap bounds the DESIGN.

_authoringNotes: WHERE EACH NUMBER CAME FROM, so the next seat does not have to guess:
+0.02 at Tier I is THE SPEC'S OWN NUMBER (:636, '+2% offline gathering
efficiency'). It is the only economic value HEART-006 actually states.
⚠ +0.02 at Tier II and Tier VII are CHOSEN, NOT RULED, and this line is here so
nobody later mistakes them for owner-authored balance. Q-ECHOFIG (RULED 13:20)
says Tier II Echo Labor and Tier VII Echo Worker Manifestations are 'modifiers
only - no new world actors, EchoWorldPresence stays the one owner'. The ruling
says they MOVE NUMBERS; it does not say which numbers. The spec's own reading of
Tier II is construction acceleration, and WO-1679 §0c proves THERE IS NO
BUILD-TIME MODIFIER SEAM IN THIS REPO to land it on - and Q-METER excludes timers
from the ceiling anyway. So both land as production-rate terms at the same
magnitude as the spec's one stated value. Retune freely; the meter is the gate.
⛔ TIER III IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Q-STONE (RULED 13:12): 'drop the Rough Stone
Discovery event.' The spec's Tier III row (:656-666) is the dropped event, and
nothing was invented to replace it. An empty tier is the honest record of a
ruling; a substitute benefit would be this lane making a design decision.
⛔ NO ROW ANYWHERE GRANTS COMBAT POWER. Q-P2W (RULED 13:10): 'economic
acceleration is allowed; combat power stays off the table.' Spec rule 10 (:25)
and the owner's standing ruling (whale tier = prestige, never a better army).
⭐ Q-LADDER (RULED 13:12): 'merge - the Heartbound tier drives polish attempts
(the polish mapping becomes a benefit row).' The two polishAttempts rows below
ARE that merge. They are placed to preserve the shipped thresholds as closely as
the merged ladder allows: NativeSkrPolishBonus granted +1 weekly re-roll at any
stake (minimum Heartbound stake is 100 SKR => Tier I) and +1 roll cap at 10,000
SKR. stakePower(10000) at zero tenure lands on Tier V - and that is MEASURED by
test/heartbound-tiers.test.js against the live ladder rather than written down
here, because a threshold copied into this file would be the second copy the
whole design forbids. Hence reroll at I, cap at V. ⚠ THAT MAPPING IS CHOSEN,
NOT RULED - the owner ruled the MERGE, not the two tier numbers.
⛔ AND THE POLISH ROWS GRANT ATTEMPTS, NEVER ODDS. PolishBonusProvider.cs:20-23:
'There is deliberately no member for odds, weights, luck, tier bias or a bonus
table, and adding one would break the property the whole economy rests on.' A
benefit row of kind polishAttempts may only carry grant extraWeeklyRerolls or
rollCapDelta - heartbound-tiers.js REFUSES any other, and its test proves it.

_comment: The closed vocabulary. heartbound-tiers.js throws on a kind not in this list, so a
future seat cannot smuggle in a 'multiplier' bag the meter would not see.
countsTowardCeiling is the Q-METER ruling expressed as data rather than as an if.

productionRate.what: a recurring percentage boost to resource yield

eventUnlock.what: adds a row to the Heart Pulse event pool

information.what: surfaces information the player could already earn

polishAttempts.what: extra ATTEMPTS at the polish table - never odds

_comment: The only two grant names a polishAttempts row may carry. Mirrors IPolishBonusProvider's two members.

benefits.note: Spec :636. OFFLINE gathering, so it lands on the offline claim path, not on the live EchoService rate. Stacks BESIDE EchoBonusCalculator.LaneContribution, never inside it (WO-1679 §6).
Q-LADDER merge. Replaces NativeSkrPolishBonus's has-any-stake test with a tier test.
Q-ECHOFIG: modifiers only, no world actor. Value chosen, not ruled - see _authoringNotes.

Q-SCOUT (RULED 13:36): 'existing report, earlier' - stakers see the EXISTING report before committing troops. The information itself stays equal for everyone; no new intel. Applied by the raid lane, not here.
Spec :684, 'small crafting convenience events become available' - an EVENT-POOL row, which is why it is not a rate. Q-METER excludes event drops from the ceiling.
Q-LADDER merge. Tier V is the closest tier to the shipped 10,000 SKR threshold - see _authoringNotes.

Q-HEARTFIRE (RULED 13:12): a SECOND Heartfire source is allowed for stakers and the single-source lint is re-pointed to permit exactly this. Re-pointing HeartfireRegression is WO-1678's lane, not this one.

Q-ECHOFIG: modifiers only. Spec :700-706 says 'temporary Echo figures can appear in the settlement'; the ruling says numbers, not figures, and EchoWorldPresence stays the single appearance owner (CLAUDE.md §7). Value chosen, not ruled.
Spec :710-714. Greenfield visual; this row exists so the panel can name the tier's identity.

Spec :728-744: maximum resonance appearance, settlement aura, banner/crest. Spec :746: 'Tier X should feel prestigious rather than economically mandatory' - which is why the ladder's LAST tier adds NO production rate at all.
Spec :740-742, 'choose one of three Echo manifestations'. A CHOICE mechanic, not a larger reward.
